method: Primary-source public web opens and targeted literature queries; no new numerical assets acquired. No exhaustive novelty claim.
queries: Arctic CDOM salinity conservative mixing optical dissolved organic matter

sources.assessment: Dataset creator documents calibrated downcast sensors, paired packs and flags. CDOM is reported in ppb; no chemically measured DOC response or CDOM quality flag is supplied.

Primary Chukchi Sea study reports that optical DOM and DOC need not correlate simply with salinity; multiple water masses matter. Different region and date, so it informs falsification rather than validating this expedition.

novelty_disposition: Not established. Predictive extensions or informative falsifications require independent literature and domain review.
